(NOW(), #{r.userId}, #{r.providerId}, #{r.providerScope}, #{r.model}, #{r.kind}, #{r.tokensInput}, #{r.tokensOutput}, #{r.costYuan}, #{r.pointsConsumed}, #{r.status}, #{r.errorMsg}, #{r.traceId}, #{r.taskId})

created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}
mapper.sql: ${dim} AS dimension_key, COALESCE(SUM(tokens_input), 0) AS tokens_input, COALESCE(SUM(tokens_output), 0) AS tokens_output, COALESCE(SUM(cost_yuan), 0) AS cost_yuan, COALESCE(SUM(points_consumed), 0) AS points, COUNT(*) AS call_count

SELECT l.id, l.created_at, l.user_id, u.username, u.name AS display_name, l.model, l.kind, l.tokens_input, l.tokens_output, l.cached_tokens, l.cost_yuan, l.points_consumed, l.status, l.error_msg, l.trace_id, l.task_id, l.project_group_id, pg.name AS project_group_name FROM llm_usage_logs l LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = l.user_id LEFT JOIN project_groups pg ON pg.id = l.project_group_id
ORDER BY l.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
